referee_caveats_inferred: Gas masses depend on a single assumed Milky Way alpha_CO and r31 = 0.5 with no metallicity or MS-dependent alpha_CO test for the target galaxies
Small samples (22 galaxies, 3 low-mu_H2) make the infall-region inference statistically weak; the A-D test compares different pairings and the CL1301.7-1139 infall subsample is only three galaxies
No per-galaxy aperture/velocity-window details; flux errors rely on a single-channel-based formula
Ks-band-dependent MAGPHYS masses and SFRs have large uncertainties (SFR errors often 50-100%) which affect the MS placement and sigma_H2 cut
Comparison with the PHIBSS2 relation involves a shift extrapolated from z=0.55 to z=0.45 using literature scaling

missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters (weighting, cell, size, cleaning) and per-target line-free channels
Per-galaxy apertures and velocity windows for the flux extraction
Calibrated or pipeline product versions and CASA version
Photometry catalogue and MAGPHYS settings for stellar masses and SFRs
Column definitions and units of the CO properties table in the text provided
Literature comparison datasets and the CL1411.1-1148 relation parameters are only cited
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Cycle 5 Band 6 compact-array data for 21 fields, 11 h including overheads; likely tens of GB of raw/calibrated measurement sets (rough estimate).
reproducibility.score_reason: Project code and key conversion factors (alpha_CO, r31, cosmology, flux formula, FWHM) are given and a numeric table exists, but imaging parameters, per-target apertures and line windows, CASA version and SED-fit inputs are not stated and several choices are inherited from the earlier paper.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public and gives no imaging or per-target extraction settings, so a faithful redo of the CO fluxes would need several guesses and external photometry for masses.

methods_papers.why: Same data reduction, alpha_CO, low-gas criterion and comparison-sample compilation as in CL1411.1-1148 (SEEDisCS I)
EAZY photometric redshifts and rest-frame colours
NFW escape velocity in phase-space diagram

companion_papers.why: SEEDisCS I, CL1411.1-1148 and its large-scale structure
ESO Distant Cluster Survey (EDisCS) from which CL1301.7-1139 was selected
